pitfalls: The DONE closure fought the environment, not the change. (1) The validate suite is ~302s vs lattice's 300s idle watchdog, so validate / story_advance-to-TEST / done_prepare must be run with LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=1200000 LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000, else they self-kill at 300s - no command actually hangs (slowest single = material-hash-large-tree ~65s; suite grew to 38 commands after merging main). (2) Killed validate runs leave a stale lock at .lattice/locks/validation/B-fbbb.lock - clear via validate forceTakeover:true (same-host dead pid). (3) Shared local main is pushed by other hosts every few minutes; each merge->refresh cycle invalidates test-evidence, the 6 verification_evidence records, and the 3 reviewer bindings, so DONE needs a quiet-main window and evidence+reviewers must be re-bound AFTER the final merge. (4) done_prepare cleanTree first requires committing pending .lattice/story metadata.
